name: Command/control word
notes: Enumerated command codes, not bit flags. GUI still exposes only forward and stop.

name: Frequency setpoint
notes: App.A.4.4 marks control bank write-only. Scale 0.01 Hz confirmed by A.8.2. 100 Hz is a software limit, not a universal device maximum.

name: AO output value
notes: AO command, 0..1000 represents 0..100 percent; documented write-only control bank.

name: Drive state/function
notes: Direction is bit 1 of 0x2101, not the state code.

name: Current fault code
notes: Numeric mapping to Err names TBD (see data/errors.csv).

name: U00.00 output frequency
notes: Example CRC-verified frame in docs/EXAMPLES.md. Suggests U-group monitors are directly addressable at 0x3000+index.
